newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold ends down, silver improves on demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold ends down, silver improves on demand.

text.p: Gold prices lost early gains on limited demand towards close of trade on Tuesday, dealers said.
Prices of gold biscuits (116.50 gramme) settled steady at 58,500 rupees per piece. They were down by 100 rupees on Monday and by 300 rupees during last week.
Gold supplies were restricted on Tuesday and sentiments subdued at the close of trade.
Silver prices ended higher on improved demand after openiong lower on fresh supplies, dealers said.
Traders said they expected the bullion market to be range-bound in the immediate future.
